summary: On August 18, 2026, Oncolytics Biotech Inc. filed a Form 8-K under Item 8.01, announcing receipt of written FDA feedback regarding design of a potential pivotal Part B expansion of its REO 033 colorectal cancer study. The feedback discusses a possible accelerated approval pathway based on objective response rate and progression-free survival. The company suggested holding an End-of-Phase meeting. This is a clinical development update, not a special situation. The filing contains no M&A, tender, restructuring, or other special-situations content. It is a routine regulatory update for a clinical-stage biotech, and thus no deal terms apply.
